text:
maria: Heads up — after last night's RBAC rollout (keystore roles) we've started seeing mTLS handshakes fail in ap-southeast. KMS Decrypt errors in proxy logs. Anyone else noticing?
jun: yep, apac-ingest + apac-proxy show repeated handshake timeouts and KMS AccessDenied in the decrypt path.
oliver: incidents alerted me 04:05 UTC. Creating an incident channel now. Short blip or still ongoing?
maria: still ongoing as of 04:12. Root cause looks like a role scoping change that removed `kms:Decrypt` from the service principal used by the keystore agent. Paste log snippet:```2026-03-18T04:02:12Z apac-ingest proxy ERROR tls_handshake: KMSDecryptError: AccessDenied (request_id=xyZ-123)```
auditbot: audit entry matched: user=infra-batch action=modify_role resource=roles/keystore-admin ts=2026-03-18T03:58:10Z request_id=abc123 diff="removed:members/service-account:keystore@redwood.internal"
katie: did the rollout target apac only or is this global? We need to avoid cascading to eu/us.
maria: rollout was intended apac-only but the automation applied a scoped role change at org-level due to an infra variable mismatch.
jun: quick mitigation: can we re-add `kms:Decrypt` to the keystore principal in apac? That should let proxies decrypt cached keys and resume handshakes.
oliver: oncall is standing by. I can approve a rollback for apac-only now. We should avoid global revert.
maria: agreed — apac rollback first, then validate. Also want to reissue any certs that failed to complete issuance.
deploy-bot: rollback job started: keystore-role-rollback-apac (job_id=5678)
jun: running commands to validate: ```gcloud iam roles describe roles/keystore-admin --project=infra-prod-apac && gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloud_kms AND protoPayload.methodName=Decrypt" --limit 10```
jun: after rollback, ran local KMS decrypt test against service-principal: OK. Proxy TLS test shows handshakes progressing. 4 services recovered so far.
maria: healthchecks showing green for apac-proxy + ingest. Thanks.
katie: followups: (1) add an audit alert rule for any role modification that affects principals with `kms:Decrypt`, (2) add a CI RBAC gating test that simulates `kms:Decrypt` deny for keystore clients, (3) add a runbook step to verify `members` scoping before role patch. I'll open PRs.
auditbot: suggested alert created draft: rule=alert-rbac-kms-decrypt-modification created_by=katie ts=2026-03-18T05:00Z
oliver: I'll file the incident ticket with timeline, logs, rollback job id, and the list of recovered services. Incident severity: S2, duration ~ 12m.
maria: action items recap: 1) rollback apac role (done by oliver/deploy-bot) 2) validate KMS decrypt + TLS handshake (jun) 3) add audit alert + CI test (katie) 4) post-incident writeup if outage > 10m (maria)
jun: putting the commands I ran in case someone needs them: ```kubectl -n infra get secret keystore-apac -o yaml | yq .data | base64 --decode; gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext=CIPHERTEXT --location=asia-southeast1 --keyring=keystore --key=agent-key --project=infra-prod-apac```
katie: PRs: #3456 (CI rbac gating), #3457 (audit alert rule). I'll link to the incident ticket when they're up.
oliver: incident ticket created: INC-2026-412 (link in incident channel). Adding SRE and Security owners.
maria: thanks all — we'll keep this thread for the postmortem notes. Please paste any logs or oddities here. Next step: add a preflight check to role automation to fail if the patch changes `members:` for service principals with kms privileges. :eyes:
